svg.title: Figure 7-1. Cybersecurity goals: what each control stops (WP-C-10 §4-§7)
svg.desc: Figure 7-1: one card per cybersecurity goal. CSG-01 (Lock the panda's safety configuration; CAL 3; TS-02 risk 5): Mode lock built (reference build, not verified); release key, RDP open. CSR-C-01 implemented, not verified. CSR-C-02 partial. CSG-02 (Only authorized firmware on the safety MCU; CAL 3; TS-03 risk 5, TS-05 risk 4): Softloader refused in a car mode; signing, RDP/WRP, recovery open. CSR-C-02 partial. CSR-C-03 not implemented. CSR-C-04 not implemented. CSR-C-05 not implemented. CSG-03 (Protect what the control software reads; CAL 2; TS-04 risk 5, TS-12 risk 4): Debug and joystick modes left out (reference build); params, IPC open. CSR-C-06 not implemented. CSR-C-07 partial. CSG-04 (Load only verified, non-executable models; CAL 2; TS-09 risk 4): No control yet: the model loader runs code, no hash check. CSR-C-08 not implemented. CSG-05 (Protect the safety-relevant CAN messages; CAL 2 provisional; TS-01 risk 4, TS-14 risk 5): No control yet: no counter or CRC on received messages. CSR-C-09 not implemented. CSG-06 (Minimal, authenticated remote access; CAL 3; TS-07 risk 4, TS-08 risk 4, TS-13 risk 3): Onroad streaming blocked; RPCs and the SSH key path still open. CSR-C-10 not implemented. CSR-C-11 partial. CSG-07 (Install only verified updates; CAL 3; TS-06 risk 4, TS-10 risk 4): No control yet: git-branch updater, in-tree hashes only. CSR-C-12 not implemented. CSR-C-13 not implemented. CSG-08 (Keep personal data and device key private; CAL 2; TS-11 risk 5, TS-07 risk 4): No control confirmed: encryption at rest unverified, no wipe. CSR-C-14 not confirmed. CSR-C-15 not implemented.
svg.text: Cybersecurity goals · what each control stops, and how far it has got
Threat → the goal's control at its element → what reaches the car. The barrier is drawn as built, from the §7 statuses.
Barrier: no barrier: not built · dashed amber: part built · dashed blue: built, not verified · solid green: verified

g.title: CSG-01: Lock the panda's safety configuration
g.text: The integrity and authenticity of the panda safety configuration (safety mode and
parameter) shall be protected so that no unauthenticated SoC-side command can
place the envelope in an unsafe configuration
Mode lock built (reference build, not verified); release key, RDP open
CSR-C-01 Enforce the Toyota mode; reject
CSR-C-02 No debug key or debug-only capabilities in release firmware

g.title: CSG-02: Only authorized firmware on the safety MCU
g.text: Only authorized firmware on the safety MCU
The integrity and authenticity of the panda firmware and its boot chain shall be
protected so that only authorized firmware runs on the safety MCU
Softloader refused in a car mode; signing, RDP/WRP, recovery open
Allocated to panda FW; SoC; user
CSR-C-02 No debug key or debug-only capabilities in release firmware
CSR-C-03 Boot only firmware verified with a current algorithm
CSR-C-04 RDP/WRP set so the firmware cannot be replaced or
CSR-C-05 The recovery path does not flash unauthenticated

g.title: CSG-03: Protect what the control software reads
g.text: Protect what the control software reads
Safety-relevant parameters and inter-process messages shall not alter actuation,
model output or driver-monitoring behaviour without integrity and authenticity
Debug and joystick modes left out (reference build); params, IPC open
CSR-C-06 Params and IPC protected, or the envelope does
CSR-C-07 No debug, maneuver or joystick modes in reference builds

g.title: CSG-04: Load only verified, non-executable models
g.text: ML model artefacts shall be loaded only after their integrity and authenticity are
verified, and loading shall not permit code execution from the artefact
No control yet: the model loader runs code, no hash check
CSR-C-08 Models load without running code from them, after a

g.title: CSG-05: Protect the safety-relevant CAN messages
g.text: The integrity and authenticity of safety-relevant vehicle-CAN messages (received
plausibility inputs and transmitted actuation) shall be protected against injection
No control yet: no counter or CRC on received messages
Allocated to panda FW; back end; user
CSR-C-09 Counter and CRC on safety-relevant RX and TX

g.title: CSG-06: Minimal, authenticated remote access
g.text: Remote access and interactive access to the device shall be minimized and
authenticated so that a compromised back end or network cannot reach safety
Onroad streaming blocked; RPCs and the SSH key path still open
CSR-C-10 SSH off by default, no embedded authorized key
CSR-C-11 No arbitrary upload, SSH tunnel or key read over RPC; onroad

g.title: CSG-07: Install only verified updates
g.text: Software updates shall be installed only after their integrity and authenticity are
No control yet: git-branch updater, in-tree hashes only
Allocated to SoC; back end; user
CSR-C-12 Install updates only after end-to-end package
CSR-C-13 Safety components under LionDriver control,

g.title: CSG-08: Keep personal data and device key private
g.text: Keep personal data and device key private
Personal data (driver-facing video, cabin imagery, location/trajectory) and the
device identity key shall be protected in confidentiality, in transit and at rest,
No control confirmed: encryption at rest unverified, no wipe
Allocated to SoC; back end; user
CSR-C-14 Personal data and the identity key confidential in
CSR-C-15 Decommissioning wipes personal data and retires

svg.text: CSR-C-16 supports every goal: A LionDriver vulnerability intake and incident-response process (not implemented).
Paraphrases quote their requirement, checked at build. Statuses, CALs, risks, allocations, gaps and claims from WP-C-10 §4-§7 and WP-C-09 §8. No exploitation detail.
